tasks.title: Console adopts the fixed contract without changing its read or write wrappers
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, Shared finding, all Behavior bullets and Completion evidence; Rollout order step 2, Security impact and Acceptance evidence (whole feature) 4. After contract merges, record or verify/reuse the same full merged main SHA as the other consumers. Keep src/api-read.ts and src/connection-test.ts redirect manual wrappers, writes and src/api-failure.ts wire-label behavior unchanged.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; lint, both typecheck projects, full tests and unchanged 80% line-coverage gate pass, including src/runtime-read.test.ts, src/connection-test.test.ts, src/check-write.test.ts and src/token-write.test.ts redirect cases.
exit 0 with no output: read/write wrappers and wire-label logic are unchanged.

Only the contract pin changes in package.json, to the same full merged contract main SHA containing #864/version 2.5.2 adopted by the other consumers, verified against main and the shared finding; bun.lock agrees. No other dependency pin changes.
exit 0 with the fixed contract installed; existing console browser flows remain passing.

CI check, docker, browser and deploy-dev pass. The deploy-dev evidence includes the repository-required Compose dev stack with this checkout and E2E_CONSOLE_FLOW=two-factor bash e2e/console-setup.sh dev/compose.yaml, exit 0 as defined in .github/workflows/ci.yml; do not edit deploy or weaken that check. PR records full merged SHA/finding provenance, required-check/browser/Compose results, empty src diff and applicable Security impact evidence for preserved manual redirects, body limits, secret-safe diagnostics and full-SHA/lockfile consistency.
